title: Support for websockets >= 17.x
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

I am unable to upgrade to Streamlit 1.64.0 because it enforces a strict upper bound on the websockets package (<17). My project requires websockets>=17.1, causing pip dependency resolution to fail.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python

```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Create a virtual environment.
2. Attempt to install both packages via pip by running:
`pip install streamlit==1.64.0 "websockets>=17.1"`

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Current Behavior

The conflict is caused by:
    The user requested websockets>=17.1
    streamlit 1.64.0 depends on websockets<17 and >=12.0.0

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

* Streamlit version: 1.64.0
* Python version: 3.10
* Operating System: Windows
* Package manager: pip

### Additional Information

The `websockets` package recently released version 17.x. Bumping the upper bound constraint in Streamlit's dependencies would prevent installation blocks for projects relying on modern websockets versions.

I think this is more of an enhancement, but looking into bumping the supported version.

This is a packaging enhancement, not a Streamlit runtime bug. Streamlit 1.64.0 (and current `develop`) declares `websockets>=12.0.0,<17` in `lib/pyproject.toml`, so `pip install streamlit==1.64.0 "websockets>=17.1"` cannot resolve. The `<17` cap was added in #15948 as the standard “next unreleased major” bound; Streamlit does not import `websockets` in production code and instead uses it as uvicorn’s WebSocket implementation (`ws="websockets-sansio"` in `starlette_server.py`). Bumping to `<18` is reasonable once 17.x is verified with that uvicorn path. That check matters because #16030 showed websockets 16.1 broke non-ASCII handshake headers, and the `websockets` maintainer planned to reintroduce that change as a documented break in 17.0 pending an uvicorn fix ([Kludex/uvicorn#3035](https://github.com/Kludex/uvicorn/issues/3035)). The lockfile is still on `websockets==16.1.1`.

### Related Issues

- [#16030](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/16030) — Closed regression where websockets 16.1 broke WebSocket handshakes with non-ASCII proxy/auth headers. Directly relevant: the 17.x major was called out as the version that would reintroduce that breaking change, so compatibility with uvicorn must be confirmed before raising Streamlit’s cap.
- [#15421](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/15421) — Same class of request: raise a server-stack dependency bound (`starlette`) so Streamlit can install alongside a newer major.
- [#15022](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/15022) — Windows `WinError 121` noise in the uvicorn/websockets read loop after the Starlette migration. Not a duplicate, but it is another signal that WebSocket-layer upgrades in this stack need careful validation.
